title: Datadog pricing - $15-$31 per host/month depending on module, plus per-GB log costs
clean_text: Datadog Infrastructure Monitoring starts at $15 per host per month billed annually ($18 on-demand), with an Enterprise infrastructure tier at $23/host/month annually ($27 on-demand) adding more dashboards and alerting depth. APM (application performance monitoring) is priced separately at $31 per host per month. Log management is billed at $0.10 per GB for indexed logs plus $1.27 per million ingested events. Costs compound quickly once multiple modules (logs, APM, RUM, custom metrics, high-cardinality tags, extended retention) are enabled together.
